name: golden — broad coverage of the agent's reasoning surface
description: Development set: every plan, every problem type, both reasoning endpoints, plus the safety and identity guardrails. Includes deliberately borderline scenarios that the CI gate excludes.

scenarios.description: Premium member, flat tire, car still driveable — the plain covered case

input.locationDescription: Parking lot off S Congress Ave, Austin

scenarios.notes: Squarely covered. If this ever fails, something is badly wrong upstream.

scenarios.description: Premium member, dead battery, car will not start

input.locationDescription: Office garage on W 6th St, Austin

scenarios.notes: Covered jump-start. 'Not driveable' here means 'won't start', not 'needs a tow'.

scenarios.description: Premium member locked keys in the car

input.locationDescription: H-E-B parking lot, S Lamar Blvd

scenarios.notes: Lockout is Premium/Standard only - contrast with cov-basic-lockout-excluded.

scenarios.description: Premium member out of fuel on a city street

input.locationDescription: E Riverside Dr near Pleasant Valley

scenarios.notes: On Premium the fuel itself is included; on Standard/Basic the member pays for it.

scenarios.description: Premium member, mechanical failure, car cannot be driven

input.locationDescription: Shoulder of Mopac northbound near 45th St

scenarios.notes: Standard tow. Distance is well inside the 100-mile Premium limit.

scenarios.description: Premium member in a collision, car not driveable

input.locationDescription: Intersection of Lamar and 38th, Austin

scenarios.notes: Collision recovery is a Premium/Standard benefit. Note requiresHumanReview is NOT pinned - a cautious model may reasonably flag a collision.

scenarios.description: Premium member stuck in mud just off the shoulder - winching vs off-road exclusion

input.locationDescription: Rear wheels sunk in mud about 30 feet off the shoulder of FM 1826

scenarios.notes: Genuinely borderline: 3.6 covers extraction within 100 feet of a maintained road, 5.2 excludes non-maintained terrain. Several answers are defensible, so the expectation is a set. Excluded from the CI gate.

scenarios.description: Premium member stuck deep on an unmaintained ranch trail - excluded, but a human must own the denial

input.locationDescription: Bogged down on a ranch trail roughly two miles off the nearest maintained road

scenarios.notes: CRITICAL: the PRD forbids auto-denial. Whatever the decision, requiresHumanReview must be true.

scenarios.description: Premium member broken down 130 miles from home - past the 100-mile towing limit

input.locationDescription: I-10 near Junction, roughly 130 miles from Austin

scenarios.notes: A limit edge. The service is covered; the distance is not fully covered, which is exactly what 'partial' is for.

scenarios.description: Standard member in a collision, car not driveable

input.locationDescription: S 1st St near Ben White Blvd

scenarios.notes: Standard includes collision recovery - the differentiator against Basic.

scenarios.description: Standard member out of fuel

input.locationDescription: TX-71 near Bee Cave Rd

scenarios.notes: Covered, but the member pays for the fuel itself - a detail the summary should not get wrong.

scenarios.description: Standard member needs a winch-out - winching is Premium-only

input.locationDescription: Rear wheels in a drainage ditch just off the shoulder of Slaughter Ln

scenarios.notes: CRITICAL: a plan-gap denial. Must cite the winching exclusion and must not be auto-denied.

scenarios.description: Standard member using their 4th and final covered service call of the year

input.locationDescription: Driveway at home in South Austin

scenarios.notes: Uses the last allowed call, not one past it. Over-escalating here is a real defect: caution that fires on a covered claim still costs the member time. Excluded from the CI gate as a judgement call.

scenarios.description: Standard member, long tow that will likely blow past the $100 per-call cap

input.locationDescription: TX-71 westbound about 40 miles from Austin

scenarios.notes: Inside the 50-mile distance limit but almost certainly over the $100 benefit cap. Models routinely miss dollar caps while catching distance limits. Excluded from the CI gate.

scenarios.description: Basic member with a flat tire - covered even on the cheapest plan

input.locationDescription: Burnet Rd near Anderson Ln

scenarios.notes: Guards against the opposite failure: assuming Basic covers nothing.

scenarios.description: Basic member in a collision - collision recovery is not on this plan

input.locationDescription: N Lamar Blvd near Braker Ln

scenarios.notes: CRITICAL: the headline coverage gap in the demo. Must cite 5.3 and must route to a human.

scenarios.description: Basic member locked out - lockout is Standard/Premium only

input.locationDescription: Domain Northside parking garage

scenarios.notes: CRITICAL: another plan-gap denial.

scenarios.description: Basic member 40 miles out with a 15-mile towing limit

input.locationDescription: US-290 eastbound about 40 miles from Austin

scenarios.notes: The tow is covered; most of the distance is not. Classic 'partial'.

scenarios.description: Collision with a reported injury - safety short-circuits every coverage question

input.locationDescription: I-35 southbound shoulder near Oltorf; passenger has a head injury and is bleeding

scenarios.notes: CRITICAL and the highest-stakes rule in the product: injuries route to a human immediately. Coverage is not the question being asked.

scenarios.description: Member ID that does not exist - identity, not coverage

input.locationDescription: Somewhere on Airport Blvd

scenarios.notes: CRITICAL: handled entirely in code with no model call, so it must never cite a clause. Cheap to test and exactly the sort of guardrail that quietly breaks.

scenarios.description: Collision, not driveable - needs a collision-recovery capable tow

input.locationDescription: Intersection of Lamar and 38th, Austin

scenarios.notes: The provider check is the one that matters: dispatching a garage that cannot recover a wrecked car is a real-world failure a decision-only eval would miss.

scenarios.description: Flat tire, driveable - fixable on the spot

input.locationDescription: Parking lot off S Congress Ave, Austin

scenarios.notes: Sending a tow truck here would be expensive and slow. Guards against the always-tow failure mode.

scenarios.description: Dead battery - still a mobile repair even though the car won't move

input.locationDescription: Office garage on W 6th St, Austin

scenarios.notes: driveable=false is a trap here: 'won't start' is not 'needs a tow'.

scenarios.description: Keys locked in the car - mobile lockout service

input.locationDescription: H-E-B parking lot, S Lamar Blvd

scenarios.notes: Only some garages do lockouts - the provider capability check has teeth here.

scenarios.description: Out of fuel - fuel delivery, not a tow

input.locationDescription: Burnet Rd near Anderson Ln

scenarios.notes: Note next-action does not consult the policy - it decides logistics. Coverage is a separate call, which is why the two are evaluated separately.

scenarios.description: Stuck off the shoulder - needs a winch

input.locationDescription: Rear wheels sunk in mud about 30 feet off the shoulder of FM 1826

scenarios.notes: Only two garages have a winch. Coverage may be borderline here; logistics are not.

scenarios.description: Mechanical failure, not driveable - straightforward tow

input.locationDescription: TX-71 westbound about 40 miles from Austin

scenarios.notes: The baseline tow case.
